title: ceterach pozoi
intro: Ceterach pozoi, commonly known as Rock Cap, is a species of fern belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ceterach pozoi include its ability to soothe irritated mucous membranes and reduce inflammation, making it a popular natural remedy for respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Ceterach pozoi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
